messages:
Mia: Heads-up 1: thinking of a micro-hygiene pilot to catch accounts stuck in the 0.30-0.50 healthscore band. Low lift, conservative rules. Thoughts?
Jorge: 👍 yes. define conservative rules please 1: what to exclude so we don't touch big accounts?
Mia: Exclude arr_bucket >= 250000 and any account with enterprise_tag=true. Also skip if onboarding_task_updated_at > (now - 30d). Non-invasive: nudge + short feedback capture only.
Priya: For sampling, can we stratify by arr_bucket (small/med) so we don't accidentally bias toward tiny accounts? pilot size 150 total, 30 for enablement outreach.
Mia: Stratified sample: 150 total, strata by arr_bucket: 60 small (<10k), 60 mid (10k-250k), 30 high (but filter enterprise out). Dedup by canonical_contact_id; pick the row with the most_recent_activity_ts.
Jorge: QA checklist add-on: verify playbook_disabled_flag, manual_hold_flag, and do_not_sweep boolean. If any true, drop from sample and replace.
Priya: Export columns I need for mapping back: account_id, account_name, canonical_contact_id, primary_contact_email, owner_id, healthscore_v3, last_seen_at, arr_bucket, onboarding_task_updated_at, playbook_disabled_flag, manual_hold_flag. Also add last_owner_change_at.
Mia: Command I'll run (internal tool):
```
./bin/cs_export --sample 150 --strata arr_bucket --dedupe canonical_contact_id --out s3://redwood-cs/micro_hygiene/pilot_1720054321.csv
```
Please confirm filters.
Jorge: Confirmed. Also add filter: last_api_call > 90d? Wait we want low activity, so last_seen_at < now - 30d. Keep last_api_call for debugging but not as an exclusion.
Priya: For feedback capture let's use a Google Sheet webhook that writes a single row per form result and sends a JSON post to playbook-runner. Fields on form: account_id, rep, result (no_response/bad_fit/needs_enablement/scheduling_call), suggested_next_step, quick_note.
Mia: playbook-runner mapping: if result==scheduling_call -> create TASK type:followup assigned to rep with due_in=3d. If needs_enablement -> create task assigned to enablement_queue. Use the webhook endpoint: https://playbook-runner.internal/api/webhook/micro_hygiene_172005
playbook-runner: webhook registered for micro_hygiene_172005. Will create tasks per mapping.
ops-bot: preview: export job queued. dry-run mode (no writes) will show counts and exclusions. Run command:
`/ops run cs_export --dry-run --sample 150 --strata arr_bucket`
Mia: Let's do dry-run first, then real export once QA signoff. Timeline: dry-run today, pilot outreach tomorrow by enablement team, collect Google Sheet results for 48h, then review and propose permanent gating rules.
Jorge: One more safety: add a circuit-breaker that prevents >10 playbook tasks per owner per day from this pilot. We don't want drowning owners.
Priya: Noted. I'll include owner_rate_limit=10 in the webhook payload and playbook-runner will enforce.
Mia: OK. @Priya please create the sheet and webhook, @Jorge please run dry-run, I'll do QA on the sample and PR the nudge template for the outreach. Sync in 30m to confirm.
Jorge: running dry-run now. ops-bot will post results when ready.
ops-bot: dry-run-complete: 150 sampled, 12 excluded (manual_hold/do_not_sweep/enterprise), final candidate set 138, stratified buckets: small=55, mid=63, high=20. S3 preview: s3://redwood-cs/micro_hygiene/preview_1720054321.csv
Mia: Nice. I'll spot-check 20 rows and then we go to pilot. Thanks team.
